column1: # The class rebuilds its whole content in rebuildMissionList(), which nulls and re-creates every
# member, so the roles come straight from the two branches:
#   not started -> overviewLabel (the CampaignOverviewETC text), difficultyListBox, actionRowPanel
#     (a row nine-patch), actionRowHighlight (the 196x51 highlight image) and actionButton (the
#     two-step "New Game"/"Create" button whose pending state is newGameConfirmStep: the first click
#     only advances the counter, the second starts the campaign with selectedDifficulty);
#   started -> scoreValue/highScoreValue plus the mission rows (missionWidgets/missionLabels, one
#     and for the story branch storyLabel with its own storyRowPanel/storyRowHighlight/startButton;
# pendingMission (H) is the mission index stored while the "existing game active" dialog is up, so
# that the confirmed action can switch to it. scoreCaption/highScoreCaption are the two grey labels
# and scoreValue/highScoreValue the red right-aligned Dungeon34 values next to them.
